mutants.fault: A submission is also authorized by a fill grant (submit treated as fill)
A fill of an autosave form is classified as a submission (over-blocking)
A request to the autosave endpoint is classified as a fill (under-blocking)
After a failed forward (5xx) to a granted recipient, the same action is authorized at every recipient
An allowed and forwarded submission is reported as DENY

mutants.deviation_note: Deny-all answers DENY at once, so the harness condition of the forwarded retries (a timeout after forwarding) cannot be produced in retry-once and retry-delayed, and the retry-delayed order proof has no first-attempt effect. These two technical deviations are named here exactly; they excuse nothing else.

mutants.fault: A DENY is reported, but the request is forwarded at once
A denied HTTP-tool request is sent 1000 ms after the closure signal of its window
As XM13a, but 20 000 ms after the signal (beyond T_q)
mutants.deviation_note: The send delayed 20 000 ms after the closure signal keeps the executor from quiescing within T_q in the three cases whose denied request goes through the HTTP tool. This T_q overrun is expected; it excuses no other timeout or error.
